title: Write the campus ambassador handbook
text:
Turn what Tomas did at Westbrook into a short guide so new ambassadors don't start from zero.

*   Ask Tomas for 30 minutes after the Westbrook launch settles down
*   What worked: posting in course group chats, the table in the library lobby
*   What didn't: flyers on notice boards (almost no sign-ups from the QR code)
*   Include the weekly check-in template and how to report bugs to Sam
